purpose: Human granularity labels for designing a fix. This is a DEVELOPMENT set: it may be inspected while designing. The fix must then be evaluated on a newly drawn, human-labelled locked set v8.
why_not_class_1_only: The class-1 gate requires headline eligibility, which requires granularity=single, so all 3,397 class-1 articles are predicted single by construction and carry no multi or roundup contrast.
why_development_set_v1_is_not_used: Its granularity labels are model-produced and unreliable for this field: on the 51 articles matching the pipeline's documented road-obstruction rule it split 28 single / 22 multi, and 31 of its 63 multi articles have a singular landslide subject in the title.

post_draw_disjointness_audit.interpretation: One exact URL overlaps model-labelled v6 despite the configured exclusion. V6 was labelled entirely by gpt-5.6-sol and its answers were not exposed in this human label pack. The defensible claim is therefore no prior human-truth overlap, not no prior model-labelled overlap.
